priority: D false or R warning or Q false -> Concentration-cautioned or limited support
P true -> Joint RNA and proteomic contrast support
otherwise -> RNA-domain support without qualified proteomic contrast support
D: reciprocal best, BH80<0.05, >=2 component metrics, no technical flag
R: max RAW or EQUAL across primary discovery inputs >=0.80
Q_historical: n>=5, coverage>=0.5, mean>0, CI_low>0, BH7<0.05, positive fraction>=0.70
Q_current_mean: same mean criterion; positive fraction shown separately
P: coverage>=0.60, interval excludes zero, matched null BH7<0.05
missing: retain missing; do not evaluate a joint group with required input unavailable
label_scope: source-alias grouping, frozen signature and reference RNA measurement
PDO: separate endpoint; excluded from group assignment
